items.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
items.summary: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

items.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
items.summary: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

items.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
items.summary: The chipmakers board is reportedly focused on investigating Huangs conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.
